say:1:1121164001:1.text: Excuse me, has anything strange happened in Ivoryshade over the last few days?
say:1:1121164001:1.source_cn: 请问——这两天月影乡里有奇怪的事情发生吗？

say:2:1121164002:1.text: Strange? I wouldn't describe it as such... but something sacred occurred right before my eyes!
say:2:1121164002:1.source_cn: 奇怪的事情？倒是有神圣的事情，刚刚就出现在我眼前！

say:3:1121164003:2.text: A giant bird flew through the air just now, its bright feathers and blazing trail burning like the sun as it flapped its wings.
say:3:1121164003:2.source_cn: 刚才空中飞过一只巨鸟，拍动翅膀时，飞羽像火焰一样在燃烧。

say:4:1121164004:0.text: I had never seen such a creature in all my life. It must've been another miracle of Misarte!
say:4:1121164004:0.source_cn: 之前从来没在山脉见过那样的鸟儿栖息，那景象让我敬畏地停...

choice_prompt:5:1121164004.text: I had never seen such a creature in all my life. It must've been another miracle of Misarte!
choice_prompt:5:1121164004.source_cn: 那之前从来没在山脉见过那样的鸟儿栖息，那景象让我敬畏地停下了脚步。那一定也是弥萨忒显灵的神迹吧。

say:6:1121164006:1.text: Sounds like Talene is searching from above!
say:6:1121164006:1.source_cn: 听起来是塔琳小姐在空中搜寻的样子！

say:7:1121164007:1.text: Which direction was it heading towards?

say:8:1121164008:3.text: It flew <style="highlight">north</style>, burning a trail through the very sky.

say:9:1121164009:1.text: Was it truly a person?! With such feathers and a wingspan that magnificent, it's unbelievable!
say:9:1121164009:1.source_cn: 那竟然是一位女士吗？！有那么美丽的羽毛和翼展，真是难以...

say:10:1121164010:1.text: Hmm, let's leave the north to Talene and ask around somewhere else.
say:10:1121164010:1.source_cn: 嗯……听起来塔琳小姐往北方去找了，那边交给她，咱们换个...

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 火焰的羽毛，难道是塔琳？

say:12:1121164005:1.text: Judging by its shadow, it was as big as a person.
say:12:1121164005:1.source_cn: 从那鸟儿的影子来看，确实有一个人那么大……

choice:5:1:2.text: Are you sure it was a bird?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 你确定自己看到的是鸟？
choice:5:1:2.male: Are you sure it was a bird?
choice:5:1:2.female: Are you sure it was a bird?
